name: Datadog Observability Platform Integration
description: Integration pack for Datadog, providing connectivity to Datadog Agent metrics, APM distributed tracing, log management, synthetic uptime monitoring, and monitor alert routing.

capabilities.name: Monitoring, Observability & SRE / Performance Engineering
capabilities.description: Integrates Datadog infrastructure agent metrics, APM flame graphs, log aggregation, and monitor alert webhooks. Integrates Datadog latency histograms, DB query performance profiling, and Synthetic browser tests.

checklists.name: Datadog Integration Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for Datadog API / Application keys, agent daemonsets, and monitor alert webhooks.

items.statement: Datadog API Key and Application Key authenticate REST API calls and Agent data ingest.
Datadog APM tracing libraries inject trace IDs across microservice HTTP/gRPC boundaries.
Datadog Monitors trigger automated webhook notifications on threshold breaches.

reviewGates.name: Datadog Observability Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Site Reliability Engineer confirms that Datadog APM tracing and monitor alert webhooks function correctly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Datadog integration confirm APM trace collection and monitor alert dispatch?
